estimates.assumptions: Standard medium head of white cabbage is ~1kg once sliced and core removed; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
Measurement already in grams; typical Polish/German smoked sausages (e.g. kielbasa) are ~290-320 kcal/100g; using 300 as average.
Single dried bay leaf weighs ~0.5g; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
2 whole dried cloves weigh ~1g total; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
12 black peppercorns weigh ~2g total; typical black pepper is ~250-260 kcal/100g.
4 dried juniper berries weigh ~2g total; typical juniper berries are ~340-370 kcal/100g.
4 dried allspice berries weigh ~2g total; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
Red wine density ~1g/ml so 90ml = 90g; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
